title: ETL pipeline for Uber Dashboard
summary: An end-to-end ETL pipeline that extracts Uber rides data from an API, loads it via Airflow into PostgreSQL, transforms it with dbt, and visualizes it in Metabase. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, loaded from a saved model file, to generate synthetic ride data resembling real business data for the FastAPI-served dashboard.
evidence: FastAPI/app/model/synthesize.py:3-9 loads and calls GaussianCopulaSynthesizer.load() to synthesize data
